Select short exact quotes carrying the source rules needed by your summary; only your verified quotes, not the full earlier context, are passed to the answer component. If required evidence is absent, state that uncertainty and request re-entry rather than inventing it. Quotes may cite only current source text or an exact earlier source excerpt, never own-state or hypotheses. Keep the summary in plain, friendly English, in complete sentences, and avoid repeating the same word twice in a row.
